arcades.info_text: BEMANICN ID: 3354. A compact arcade on 2F of Tianjin Impression City in Xiqing District. Warm reminder displayed on-screen: the Initial D Zero online service will terminate on December 15, 2025. Features 2 Initial D Zero cabinets (4 coins per credit, offline only) and 1 Taiko no Tatsujin Nijiiro in good condition (12 coins per credit, 4 songs per play). Also houses 4 Asphalt 9 DX Arcade. The arcade often runs promotions with coin prices as low as 0.17 CNY each. No maimai cabinet — this is a Taiko-focused venue.
